Locate the bracketing progress rows and interpolate p[k]=I(a,b,t), linearly or spherically. Empty non-clock tracks output zero; absent clock samples are NaN. Clock sampleTimes are k*clockStep relative to clock start, while other sampleTimes are relative to track start.
